engine_probe.detail: No external engine is required to generate this target.

dialogue.note: Paragraph whitespace is normalized by the target.

unicode.note: Ink string escaping is verified but target font rendering is not.

engine_probe.detail: The installed Ren'Py 8.5.4 SDK launcher is required to run the project and is never bundled. Version probing uses the launcher command line; if the installed launcher does not answer --version the probe reports PROBE_FAILED, never a guessed version.

conditions.note: Approved bounded bool/int and/or/not comparisons become Ren'Py if conditions and conditional menu items.

bool_variables.note: Bounded boolean variables become default bool variables assigned by inline Ren'Py assignments.

int_variables.note: Bounded integer variables become default integer variables with the approved bounds preserved.

assignment.note: Choice assignments are emitted as one typed inline assignment per approved target variable.

dialogue.note: Dialogue and speaker names use the authority escape; target font, line wrapping and whitespace rendering are not verified.

choices.note: Every menu item is gated by its approved typed condition; a disabled choice cannot be selected.

endings.note: Ending nodes display the approved ending text and return to the Ren'Py main menu.

loops.note: Cycles are projected as labels and jumps and execute until the approved step cap; bounded analysis is not an unbounded proof.

step_cap.note: The generated script checks ans_steps against the approved max_steps before every menu and returns instead of exceeding it.

save.note: Ren'Py native persistence serializes variables and the current label; this generated project ships no save UI screens, so in-game save controls are out of scope and cross-re-export save compatibility is not guaranteed.

restore.note: Ren'Py native persistence restores variables and the current label; this generated project ships no load UI screens and SAVE_RESTORE_VERIFIED is BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT on this host.

unicode.note: UTF-8 text with Chinese, quotes, newlines and interpolation/markup punctuation is escaped; target font and bidi rendering are not verified.

media.note: The approved story references no media assets; in all cases no media bytes are packaged or played.

assignment.note: Bounded typed assignments are applied before the node transition.

dialogue.note: Dialogue is shown with plain Labels; BBCode/HTML is never parsed.

loops.note: Node transitions may revisit a node; the runtime enforces the explicit step cap.

step_cap.note: The explicit max_steps from the reviewed story is enforced by the runtime.

save.note: Save to a bounded local user:// JSON file.

restore.note: Restore validates story/revision/digests and replays the saved path before continuing.

unicode.note: UTF-8 text, CJK content and escaping are preserved and compared headlessly; GUI font glyph coverage is not verified.

media.note: Approved asset references are recorded as IDs only; no media bytes are packaged or played.

notes: Bounded typed state search completed; all declared ending witnesses replay exactly.
Headless runtime acceptance is recorded separately from generation; generation is not execution.

conditions.note: Bounded bool/int comparisons, and/or/not; rendered as Ink conditions and asserted per step.

bool_variables.note: Boolean variables map to Ink boolean VARs and runtime values are type-checked.

int_variables.note: Int variables are bounded to +/-10000 and stay exact in Ink integers and JS numbers.

assignment.note: Constant choice assignments only; bounds are validated before rendering.

dialogue.note: Each non-empty dialogue line is preserved; blank lines and paragraph spacing normalize in Ink text output.

choices.note: Every enabled choice label is asserted against the runtime choice list, in order.

endings.note: Every discovered ending witness plays to its ending state in the pinned runtime.

loops.note: Cycles replay until the generated explicit step cap; the cap case is part of acceptance.

step_cap.note: The generated ans_steps branch ends the story at the exact max_steps cap.

save.note: story.state.ToJson() is captured at every acceptance step.

restore.note: A fresh process restores the saved state with LoadJson and resumes to the ending.

unicode.note: UTF-8 dialogue/choice text including emoji and escapes is asserted exactly; target font rendering is not verified.

media.note: Approved asset references remain manifest-only; no media bytes are bundled or played.

notes: Consumes the same frozen typed subset as INKJS_2_3_2_TYPED_TEXT_SUBSET; the legacy target and its bundle bytes are unchanged.
acceptance/witness.json drives target-environment acceptance; generating the bundle is not running it.
